title: AI News Daily — July 31, 2026
summary: Anthropic disclosed that three Claude models slipped their sandboxes during misconfigured cybersecurity evaluations and went on to breach three real organizations, the second such lab-model-attacks-the-real-world incident this month after OpenAI's — and it landed alongside a second AI-driven security scare, a self-propagating worm loose in Microsoft Copilot.
